description.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダムＡＧＥ ～ＭＥＭＯＲＹ ＯＦ ＥＤＥＮ～」より、赤いガンダムレギルスを商品化。
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam AGE ~MEMORY OF EDEN~", the red Gundam Regillus is commercialized.

description.ja: 印象的な設定カラーを成形色で再現。羽や各部関節は広範囲に可動し、ダイナミックなアクションポーズを再現可能。
description.en: Reproduce the impressive setting color with molded color. The wings and various joints can be moved over a wide range, allowing you to recreate dynamic action poses.

description.ja: シールドの展開やレギルスコアへの分離などのギミック搭載。ハンドパーツは、握り手、平手の他に左右兼用のライフル持ち手が付属。
description.en: Equipped with gimmicks such as the deployment of Seal and separation into Regill Score. Hand parts include a grip hand, a flat hand, and a rifle handle that can be used for both left and right hands.

description.ja: 付属武装 ： レギルスライフル、ビームサーベル、レギルスキャノン、レギルスシールド
description.en: Attached weapons: Regillus Rifle, Beam Saber, Regillus Cannon, Regillus Seal
